```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(cowplot)
```

```{r load}
# load amazon books data
books <- read_csv("amazonbooks.csv")
books <- na.omit(books)
```
# Data cleaning

```{r}
library(janitor)
books <- books |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  mutate(
    length = case_when(num_pages <= 400 ~ "short",
                       num_pages > 400 ~ "long"),
    list_price= case_when(list_price >50 ~ NA,
                              list_price <=50~list_price))

set.seed(2917)
book_imp <- mice::mice(books)
books2 <- complete(book_imp,1)

rm(books)
```

# Class Activities

## Normal models

```{r}
# Book weight by binding type

gg1 <- books2 |> 
  ggplot(aes(x= weight_oz))+ 
  geom_histogram(color= "black", fill = "gray", bins = 15)+ 
  labs(title = "Weight of Amazon books", 
       x = "Weight (oz)")+
  theme_bw()+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n=10))

ggsave("./plots/book_weight_histogram.png",
      plot = gg1,
      width= 5, 
      height= 3, 
      dpi = 300)

books2 |> 
  summarise(mean = mean(weight_oz),
            sd = sd(weight_oz))
```

## SLR crash course


```{r}
model1 <- lm(weight_oz ~ num_pages, data = books2)
model1 |> tidy()
```

## MLR with categorical variables

```{r}
model2 <- lm(weight_oz ~ num_pages + hard_or_paper, data = books2)
model2 |> tidy()

```

## MLR with interaction

```{r}

model3 <- lm(weight_oz ~ height*length, data = books2)
model3 |> tidy()

gg2 <- books2 |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = height, y = weight_oz, colour = length, lty = length)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)+ 
  theme_bw()+ 
  labs(y = "Weight (oz)", x = "Height (in)")

ggsave("./plots/book_weight_int_histogram.png",
      plot = gg2,
      width= 5, 
      height= 3, 
      dpi = 300)
```



## Model comparison 

```{r}

model1 <- lm(weight_oz ~ num_pages, data = books2)
model2 <- lm(weight_oz ~ num_pages+ hard_or_paper, data = books2)
model3 <- lm(weight_oz ~  height*length, data = books2)
model4 <- lm(weight_oz ~ num_pages*hard_or_paper, data = books2)
model5 <- lm(weight_oz ~ height*length + hard_or_paper, data = books2)

list(
  model1 = model1,
  model2 = model2,
  model3 = model3,
  model4 = model4,
  model5 = model5
) |>
  map_dfr(
    ~ glance(.x) |>
      select(r.squared, adj.r.squared, AIC, BIC),
    .id = "model"
  )

```
